newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Opposition group to set up a new party in Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Opposition group to set up a new party in Morocco.

text.p: An opposition group, which just broke away from the Socialism and Progress Party (SPP), announced on Tuesday its decision to set up a new "democratic" party, the official MAP news agency reported.
Led by Thami Khyari, a university professor and member of parliament, the new group called "Front of Democratic Forces", plans to hold its constitutive assembly by end July, MAP said.

"Our target is to renovate the political action (in Morocco), lay down a structure of democratic rules inside the party before a nation-wide struggle for real democratic institutions," MAP quoted the group as saying.
Morocco has a dozen political parties including SPP, headed by the 70-year old veteran politician Ali Yata.
